verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community confirmation of specific YubiKey form factors (USB-C, USB-A, keychain, nano) — only general docs about protocols/SDKs and community comments about size/bulkiness in vague terms (e.g., yubikey-comm-9 says 'more compact and less bulky' without specifics). Missing for 10: explicit product-line documentation of USB-A/USB-C variants, nano/keychain form factors, and any independent confirmation of the lineup breadth.
